entities.summary:
Cognitive process whereby something new and somehow valuable is formed.

Creativity is a fundamental aspect of human history, spanning 72,000 years from Prehistory to the Digital Age. It encompasses various forms of innovation, artistic expression, and problem-solving that have shaped the world we live in today. From the earliest cave paintings to modern technological advancements, creativity has been a driving force behind human progress.

Throughout history, creativity has taken many forms, from the works of ancient Greek philosophers to the discoveries of Renaissance scientists. It has been the catalyst for social change, technological innovation, and artistic expression. From the pyramids of Giza to the Starry Night, creativity has left an indelible mark on human civilization.

As we continue to navigate the complexities of the modern world, creativity remains a vital component of human existence. It inspires us to new heights, challenges our assumptions, and pushes the boundaries of what is possible.

In the words of Albert Einstein, 'Imagination is more important than knowledge. Knowledge is limited. Imagination encircles the world.
